arrives.description: For a planned check, the change it arrives with.

detail.description: In plain words: what passed, what it found, or what is missing.
examples: 1 found in 2 approval(s) and 1 release(s) of the last day: Approved with the signature of whoever prepared it or asked for it

evidence.description: A link to its evidence, where there is one: a CI check's asset of the release the platform runs.

frequency.description: CI on every change, daily, nightly, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annually, or on an event.

how.description: What runs it: make <target>, test <Go test> or ci <job> in CI; job <platform job>; check <catalogue check>; verify <verification>; attestation <review>; tofu <module>/<run> for a check that runs in the cloud.

keeps.description: What its evidence is and where it is kept, as the registry says.
examples: the latest run for the organisation (fyniq.control_run)

kind.description: ci: in CI, read from the release the platform runs. job: a platform job. check: a check of the catalogue (Appendix C). verify: a verification compliance.run makes nightly. attestation: a review a person signs off. cloud: it runs only in the cloud. none: nothing runs it yet.

state.description: running: it runs here. planned: it arrives with a later change, named in arrives. manual: checked by hand. cloud: built, run only in the cloud.
